newsitem.title: USA: Tri-Valley gas well in California begins producing.
newsitem.headline: Tri-Valley gas well in California begins producing.

text.p: Tri-Valley Oil & Gas Co on Thursday said it started producing more than 4.0 million cubic feet per day of natural at its Webb Tract No. 1 well after the dual completion of the Martinez and Hamilton zones.
The Webb Tract No. 1 is located in the Sacramento delta of California near the convergence of the Sacramento and San Joaquin rivers.
The company, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Tri-Valley Corp, said the well brought Tri-Valley's operated production to more than eight million cubic feet per day.
